name: Object Space Ray Setup — Camera Space Transformation for Ray Origin, Local Space Ray Setup, Object Space Ray Casting
aliases: Ray Origin Calculation for Near Plane Quad
definition: Calculates the ray origin in volume texture space for a given vertex on the near plane quad, used for testing ray casting shaders.
summary: This method calculates ray origins in volume texture space by transforming view-space vertices to world space and mapping them to local volume coordinates, differing from camera-space setups by operating directly on object-space vertices.
